name: Shenzhen Aoni Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Aoni Electronic Co., Ltd. is a company that focuses on the research, development, manufacturing, and global sales of audio and video hardware and software. Its product range includes devices such as video conferencing cameras, intelligent network surveillance cameras, automotive cameras (including driving recorders), various advanced headsets like TWS (True Wireless Stereo), noise-canceling, and AI-powered models, as well as smart cameras and speaker systems for meeting environments. The company also dedicates efforts to technological advancements in areas including cloud computing, mobile applications, embedded systems, production testing, advanced cloud technologies, artificial intelligence algorithms, electronic circuit design, structural engineering, and comprehensive test verification. Furthermore, it provides manufacturing services to other brands. Established in 2005 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, Shenzhen Aoni Electronic Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Shenzhen Aoxintong Innovation Investment Co., Ltd.
